title: Generation of non-human primate CAR Tregs using artificial antigen-presenting cells, simian tropic lentiviral vectors, and antigen-specific restimulation
protocol: Dispense anti-coagulated blood into a 50 mL conical tube.
Spin the tube at 650 g for 10 minutes at room temperature with deceleration and acceleration on lowest speed.
Pipette off the clear plasma layer, leaving behind the RBC/PBMC enriched layer.
Dilute the remaining RBC/PBMC layer with one volume of PBS.
Place 15 mL of room temperature 60% Percoll solution into a new 50 mL conical tube, avoiding contact with the sides.
Slowly overlay up to 35 mL blood on top of the Percoll solution.
Centrifuge the blood for 30 minutes at 650 g with deceleration and acceleration on lowest speed.
Pipette off the top layer until approximately 2.5 cm above the interphase.
Collect the hazy middle layer containing PBMCs using a pipette and transfer it to a new tube.
Fill up a new 50 mL conical tube with PBS for washing cells.
Spin the cells at 650 g for 10 minutes with deceleration and acceleration returned to their highest settings.
Remove the supernatant.
Lose red blood cells using ACK lysis buffer.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL of ACK lysis buffer.
Fill up tube to 50 mL with ACK lysis buffer.
Rock tube gently for 8 min at room temperature.
Spin cells for 10 min at 650 g.
If cellular debris is visible following lysis, strain sample through a 70 μm filter into a new 50 mL conical tube before centrifugation.
Resuspend cells in 300 μL of flow cytometry buffer and move to a sterile FACS tube.
Perform a low-pressure sort using a 100 μm nozzle into 5 mL polypropylene tubes containing 1 mL of R10 medium as a cushion.
Use the flow sorter’s FSC threshold to eliminate platelets from the screen.
Gate on single cells based on trigger pulse width vs. FSC.
Gate on lymphocytes based on SSC vs. FSC.
Among CD4+ CD8- cells, gate on the top 1%–2% of CD25+ CD127- cells.
Finally, gate on CD45RA+ cells.
Make antibody staining master mix containing titrated amounts of CD4-BV421, CD8α-BV510, CD25-PE/Dazzle 594, CD127-PE, and CD45RA-FITC antibodies.
Add the antibody staining master mix to cells.
Vortex tubes to mix well.
Put tubes in 4°C refrigerator for 15 min.
Wash cells with 3 mL flow buffer, spin for 10 min at 650 g at room temperature.
Resuspend cells in 500 μL flow buffer.
Filter cells through a 35 μM strainer top moved from a polystyrene FACS tube onto a sterile polypropylene FACS tube.
Count cells and adjust to 20 × 10^6 cells/mL with flow buffer.
Sort Tregs stringently for clinical use.
Expand sorted Tregs into clinical-sized doses starting from as few as 25k Tregs.
Choose a plate or flask with a smaller surface area for each day of restimulation to ensure physical contact between aAPCs and T cells.
Re-stimulate CAR-transduced cells exclusively using K562.Bw6.86 cells during weeks 1–2 despite minimal absolute growth.
Monitor the percentage increase of CAR+ Tregs in contrast to antigen non-specific stimulation in week 1.
Observe stimulated Tregs under microscopy for quality control.
Demonstrate enrichment of CAR+ cells by antigen-specific restimulation through analysis and staining at the end of each week during Treg growth.
Spin down sorted Tregs and count cells.
Plate 25k–100k Tregs in 200 μL R10 medium with 100k irradiated K562.F12Q.86 cells and 300 IU/mL IL-2 in a 96 well flat bottom plate.
After 48 h, add ½ vial of Bw6-28z virus dropwise to the cells.
Move cells to a 48 well plate after 24 hours.
Double the volume of R10 and add IL-2 back to 300 IU/mL on day 5.
Adjust cell concentration to 500k cells/mL with R10 on day 5.
Add IL-2 to cells at 300 IU/mL assuming consumption on day 7.
Take 50k cells for surface staining flow cytometry on day 7.
Stain in 100 μL of flow buffer containing titrated amounts of Fixable Viability Dye eFluor 780, CD4-BV421 (OKT4), CD8α-BV510 (RPA-T8), and CD25-PE/Dazzle 594 (BC96).
Stain cells with HLA-B7 Tetramer-PE.
Adjust remaining cells to a concentration of 500k cells/mL with R10 medium.
Add 1 irradiated K562.Bw6.86 cell per Treg and add 300 IU/mL IL-2, assuming consumption.
Double the media on day 9 with R10 containing 600 IU/mL IL-2 and move cells to an appropriate plate or flask.
Count cells and adjust to a concentration of 500k cells/mL with R10 medium on day 11.
Add IL-2 to 300 IU/mL, assuming consumption on day 11.
Repeat the steps from days 7/9/11 on day 14/16/18, but with a 1:2 ratio of aAPCs to Tregs.
Freeze up to 50 × 10^6 Tregs in 1 mL of 90% FBS + 10% DMSO solution when cells reach the resting state.
Wash 500k cells in 3 mL flow buffer for assessing Treg product by flow cytometry.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL flow buffer containing titrated amounts of CD4-BV605, CD8α-BV510, CD127-PerCP/Cy5.5, CD25-BV421, and Fixable Viability Dye eFluor 780.
Incubate the cells in a 4°C refrigerator for 30 minutes.
Wash cells with 3 mL flow buffer after incubation.
Spin down the cells for 5 minutes at 485 g.
During spin, prepare 1× Fix Solution by adding 250 μL 4× TrueNuclear Fix Concentrate to 750 μL Fix Diluent.
Decant liquid and resuspend cells in 1 mL TrueNuclear Fix Solution after spinning.
Vortex the cells well and incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes in the dark.
Mix 1 part 10× Perm Buffer with 9 parts Milli-Q water to prepare 6.5 mL of 1× Perm Buffer per sample.
Incubate samples as required.
Add 2 mL of prepared 1× Perm Buffer to the cells and centrifuge at 485 g for 5 minutes.
Decant the supernatant, add another 2 mL of 1× Perm Buffer, and spin down again at 485 g for 5 minutes.
Prepare intracellular antibody master mix by diluting titrated amounts of FoxP3-PE/Dazzle 594 (206D), CTLA-4-BV786 (BNI3), Helios-PE/Cy7 (22F6), and HLA-B7 Tetramer-PE in 100 μL of 1× Perm Buffer.
Add the antibody master mix to the cells, vortex gently, and incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Wash cells with 2 mL of 1× Perm Buffer, centrifuge at 485 g for 5 minutes.
Wash cells again with 3 mL flow buffer by spinning them down at 485 g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the cells in 200 μL of flow buffer for analysis on a flow cytometer.
Thaw 1 vial each of Bw6- K562 cells, Bw6+ K562 cells, and K562.F12Q.86 cells.
Resuspend cells at 4 × 10^6 cells/mL in R10.
Wash CAR Tregs with R10 and resuspend cells at 2 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Add 50 μL (0.1 × 10^6 cells) of CAR Tregs to each of 4 wells in a 96 well polystyrene round bottom plate.
Add one of the following: 50 μL R10 medium, 50 μL parental K562 cells, 50 μL K562.Bw6 cells, or 50 μL K562.F12Q.86 cells.
Add 100 μL of R10 containing 600 IU/mL IL-2 to each well.
Incubate cells for 24 h at 37°C/5% CO2.
Put entire contents of each well into a flow cytometry tube containing 3 mL flow buffer.
Spin down cells at 485 g for 5 min.
During spin, resuspend the titrated amounts of CD4-BV421, CD8α-BV510, LAP-APC, and Fixable Viability Dye eFluor 780 in flow cytometry buffer per sample.
Add 100 μL of the master mix to each sample.
Incubate cells for 15 min at 4°C.
Wash tubes with 3 mL flow cytometry buffer.
Spin down tubes at 485 g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend cells in 200 μL of 2% PFA.
Analyze resuspended cells on a flow cytometer.
Remove one vial of CellTrace Violet (CTV) from the freezer.
Allow the CTV vial to warm to room temperature before opening.
Pulse spin the tube to pool reagent at the bottom of the tube.
Resuspend CTV in 20 μL anhydrous DMSO to generate a 5 mM stock solution.
Wash cells once with PBS and resuspend up to 25 × 10^6 PBMCs in 1 mL PBS.
Dilute CTV stock 1:100 to obtain a 50 μM working stock solution.
Add 110 μL of the 50 μM CTV working stock for every 1 mL of cells in PBS for a final concentration of 5 μM.
Mix well and incubate for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Dilute the CTV stock with PBS just before labeling the cells to avoid hydrolysis.
Add 5 volumes of R10 to remove free dye from solution.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Spin down cells for 5 minutes at 485 g.
Freeze cells in aliquots of 2.5 × 10^6 cells/vial in 90% FBS / 10% DMSO.
Wash CAR Tregs and Teffs with R10 medium three times to eliminate residual IL-2.
Resuspend cells in R10 at a concentration of 750k cells/mL.
Thaw frozen, CTV labeled PBMCs as specified.
Wash cells twice with R10 medium.
Resuspend cells at 750k cells/mL in R10.
Add 20 μL of α-CD3/α-CD28 beads to 100 μL of R10 in an Eppendorf tube.
Spin cells in a tabletop centrifuge for 5 min at 300 × g.
Remove media and resuspend beads in 500 μL R10 medium.
Count the beads.
Adjust beads to 375k beads/mL.
Add 134 μL Tregs (100k cells) to well B2 in a 96 well round bottom polystyrene plate.
Fill wells B3-B7 with 67 μL fresh R10 each.
Perform 1:1 serial dilution of Tregs by moving 67 μL from B2 through B7.
Remove the last 67 μL from well B7 so that all wells contain 67 μL of CAR Tregs.
Add 67 μL of CTV labeled PBMCs (50k cells) to each well B2-B7.
Add 67 μL of beads (25k beads) to each well B2-B7.
Repeat steps for Teffs instead of Tregs in wells C2-C7.
Add 67 μL of PBMCs and 134 μL R10 to well D2 as an unstimulated control.
Add 67 μL of PBMCs, 67 μL beads, and 67 μL R10 to well D3 as an unsuppressed control.
Add 67 μL PBMCs, 67 μL Tregs, and 67 μL R10 to wells D4-D7 for CTV compensation control.
Fill surrounding wells with 200 μL PBS.
Place plate in a 37°C/5% CO2 incubator for 4 days.
Stain each well for flow cytometry analysis.
Use titrated amounts of CD4-AF488 (OKT4) in 100 μL flow buffer.
Use titrated amounts of CD8α-BV510 (RPA-T8) in 100 μL flow buffer.
Stain with Fixable Viability Dye eFluor 780 in 100 μL flow buffer.
Pool wells D4-D7 and leave unstained for accurate compensation of CTV fluorescence.
Use the unstained cells to set proper voltage on the flow cytometer.
Determine division index for each tube using FlowJo’s proliferation platform.
Calculate level of suppression using the formula provided.
